page.layout: One page of text: a single column of verse, 24 lines, with the signature "A. T. H." at the right below the last line and "FINIS." centred below that. No running head, catchword or signature mark.

main_text.p: Omnia complectens,nulli tamen ipse prebensus: Omnibus infusus,labis at omnis inops: Abripe me sursum,miro cum flamine mirus Allabens lutea pectora fece laua: Inq; tuam rape naturam,correptaq; flammis Attenua,& formans attenuata soue. Unum sim tecum,maneam tibi semper adhærens, Numen idem ueluti cum genitore manes. Plasma tuum instaura natiuo crimine fissum, Assere & amissum uindice iure tibi: Ut mea damna meo fatear tribuamq; furori, Atq; accepta tibi commoda cuncta[?] feram: Qui mira bonitate malum conuertere nostrum In tua lætaris,Christe benigne,bona. Pectoris ab hyemem,si non pietate calescat Tam mira,& uero flagret amore tui. Attonitum ab mentis somnum tristemq; ueternum, Ni uigilet tantis illa agitata bonis. Hoc opus haud nostræ:me Patris ô alma uoluptas Christe mihi occidas,sic tibi uiuus agam: Meq; mihi excidas,uiti quo palmes adorner Florefcamq; tibi,marcidus ipse mihi. Incipiam nihil esse mihi:sic omnia abundè Aducenient gremio suppeditata tuo.

page.notes: The "e" in "rape" carries a mark that may be a macron or tilde; read as "rape". "cuncta" is set with a ligature that is hard to read; [?] added. Long s is plain s throughout. Capital V used as vowel has been normalised to U (Unum, Ut). The "A" of "Allabens" is capitalised as printed.
